title: MES
description: Editable shop-order workspace over the installed MES objects and actions. Installation creates drafts only; review and activate a candidate before replacing the native entry. / 基于已安装 MES 对象和动作的可编辑工单工作区。安装只创建草稿；查看并激活候选后才替换原生入口。

blueprint.guide: Requires an installed native MES. Create the original Build drafts, edit mesorders in Workshop, then review and activate the application candidate. The native MES keeps its records, actions and other screens. ShopOrders remains until the owner confirms the replacement task is equivalent. / 需要已安装原生 MES。创建原 Build 草稿，在 Workshop 编辑 mesorders，再查看并激活应用候选。记录、动作及其他页面继续归原生 MES。负责人确认替代任务等价前保留 ShopOrders。
